commitThreshold: a bounded drawn path with at least three points
memoryRule: a drawn path becomes a material field; the source filament absorbs, a remote filament grows, and a counter-filament unthreads; later strokes inherit the changed spine
interactionRule: pointerdown and pointermove preview a geometry-neutral path; pointerup commits a bounded stroke; Enter, Space, and feed a stroke use deterministic paths; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: closed attention body, horizontal temporal score, and compound pressure sheet -> one open SVG spine with seven unequal filaments
compositionRupture: central body, row, and slab -> off-axis open organism with distributed strands and no enclosing contour
encounterRupture: dwell, timed second beat, and pressure hold -> continuous drawn path whose trace is refused and whose field acts remotely
temporalRupture: attention ledger, interval score, and pressure events -> four inherited growth states where the next contour is produced from the changed organism
mediumRupture: even-odd filled bodies and token paths -> open stroke-based SVG geometry with actual path production
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
